Ideas:
1. `read_line`: it does `self.window.view(LINE_WINDOW)` then find, then slice, then advance + `self.pos = self.window.pos`. I can avoid the `self.pos` sync by making `self.pos` a property reading `window.pos`... or just use `self.window.pos` directly. Small win.

2. `field_block`: builds a bytearray with `_prefix` calls. 2 calls per field + the count. With the PREFIX table ✓. Could I avoid the intermediate bytearray by hashing incrementally? The cache handles the hash ✓. The bytearray build is ~120 × 3 ops ✓.

3. `read_field`: `content.find(b':')`, `TOKEN.fullmatch(name)`, `FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch(raw)`, `raw.strip(b' \t')`. I could combine the last two: strip first, then fullmatch on the stripped value... but the strip changes the valid set? No — stripping only removes SP/HTAB which are allowed anyway ✓. So: `value = raw.strip(b' \t')` then `FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch(value)`. Hmm, that doesn't save a call.

Actually — I could skip `FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch(raw)` when `raw == value` (i.e., nothing was stripped)? No, the content still needs validation.

Hmm, what about validating the value bytes with a translation-based check? `raw.translate(None, delete=b' \t')`? No.

That replaces find + TOKEN.fullmatch + FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch = 3 calls with 1 ✓. 

5. `view()`: the overhead per call is ~1µs. Could I inline the buffer logic in read_line? Marginal.

6. The request-line checks: `content.split(b' ')` + 3 fullmatches. Could use one regex: `REQUEST_RE = re.compile(rb"([!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+) ([\x21-\x7e]+) HTTP/1\.1\Z")` ✓ one call.

content.text: Let me optimize the per-line hot path (single regex for field/request lines) and measure CPU time:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
path='modules/capture_audit.py'
src=open(path).read()
src = src.replace("""TOKEN = re.compile(rb"[!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+\\Z")
TARGET = re.compile(rb'[\\x21-\\x7e]+\\Z')
FIELD_VALUE = re.compile(rb'[\\x20-\\x7e\\x09]*\\Z')
DECIMAL = re.compile(rb'[0-9]+\\Z')
HEX = re.compile(rb'[0-9a-fA-F]+\\Z')""",
"""TOKEN = re.compile(rb"[!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+\\Z")
TARGET = re.compile(rb'[\\x21-\\x7e]+\\Z')
FIELD_VALUE = re.compile(rb'[\\x20-\\x7e\\x09]*\\Z')
REQUEST_LINE = re.compile(
    rb"([!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+) ([\\x21-\\x7e]+) HTTP/1\\.1\\Z")
FIELD_LINE = re.compile(
    rb"([!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+):([\\x20-\\x7e\\x09]*)\\Z")
DECIMAL = re.compile(rb'[0-9]+\\Z')
HEX = re.compile(rb'[0-9a-fA-F]+\\Z')""")

old = """    def read_field(self, content):
        colon = content.find(b':')
        if colon <= 0:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        name = content[:colon]
        if TOKEN.fullmatch(name) is None:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        raw = content[colon + 1:]
        if FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch(raw) is None:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        return name, raw.strip(b' \\t')"""
new = """    @staticmethod
    def read_field(content):
        match = FIELD_LINE.fullmatch(content)
        if match is None:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        return match.group(1), match.group(2).strip(b' \\t')"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

old = """        content = self.read_line()
        parts = content.split(b' ')
        if len(parts) != 3:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        method, target, version = parts
        if TOKEN.fullmatch(method) is None:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        if TARGET.fullmatch(target) is None:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        if version != b'HTTP/1.1':
            raise ChannelError('syntax')"""
new = """        content = self.read_line()
        match = REQUEST_LINE.fullmatch(content)
        if match is None:
            raise ChannelError('syntax')
        method = match.group(1)
        target = match.group(2)"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open(path,'w').write(src)
print('optimized')
EOF
